verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair axis for a vector database with SDKs and APIs. The evidence pack never mentions a versioned API scheme, compatibility guarantees, or a deprecation policy. The only related signals are a versioned docs path (v3.0.x) and a note that Milvus Lite shares the same API as the other deployment modes, and neither shows the capability. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.
